_about.what: Two sample journeys built on Activity_Fields_v1. Every field listed for each activity is filled. Names, companies, IDs and numbers are invented.
_about.common_fields: Each activity carries occurred_at, source_label (Heard shows as "Counselling call on {date}") and moved_from_another_business; each field carries its source system, source field and status.
_about.flags: Fields whose status is "No source today" or "Open question" carry value_note so the prototype can mark them.

people.headline: MSc Business Analytics graduate in Manchester · came through the upGrad Study Abroad pathway

After a webinar, a counselling call and a face-to-face session with her parents she enrolled, did year 1 online (82%), applied for year 2, got an unconditional offer and her visa, and reached Manchester in September 2025.
